resources.string: A quieter Home screen. A few essential apps. A little intention before you leave.

For sideloaded APKs on Android 13+, open App Info → tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings. On the same page, set Battery to Unrestricted / Do not optimize.
Step 2: Enable Focus Harbor in Accessibility
Turn Focus Harbor on in Accessibility Settings. It checks foreground package names only (canRetrieveWindowContent=false) and never reads chats or screen text.

Focus Harbor is a reversible focus launcher, not a permanent device lock.

Open-ended sessions: tap Leave focus anytime (with 10+ words if enabled).

Strict timebound sessions (max 180 min): Leave focus stays locked until the timer reaches 00:00, then Finish unlocks in one tap and App Guard stops blocking automatically.

Strict App Guard (optional): uses a package-only Accessibility check (canRetrieveWindowContent=false; never reads screen text) to bounce non-allowlisted apps and Recents back to Focus Harbor.

Emergency & Safe Mode recovery: Phone dialer and emergency call UI are always exempted. Restarting Android into Safe Mode (hold Power → long-press Restart) disables all third-party launchers and Accessibility services immediately.

No root, device-owner/admin, overlay, VPN, or package disabling is used.
